Q14.purpose: Overall revenue drop and P001's share of the total decline
Q14.sql:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN date < '2026-09-01' THEN unit_price_usd * quantity ELSE 0 END) AS rev_before_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2026-09-01' THEN unit_price_usd * quantity ELSE 0 END) AS rev_after_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN date < '2026-09-01' THEN unit_price_usd * quantity ELSE 0 END) -
   SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2026-09-01' THEN unit_price_usd * quantity ELSE 0 END) AS rev_drop_total,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN date < '2026-09-01' THEN unit_price_usd * quantity ELSE 0 END) -
   SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2026-09-01' THEN unit_price_usd * quantity ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 /
   NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN date < '2026-09-01' THEN unit_price_usd * quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pct_drop
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-09-30';

Q18.purpose: Email share of total sessions and orders in Aug vs Sep

       email_sessions/total_sessions AS email_share_sessions,
       email_orders/total_orders AS email_share_orders

Q21.purpose: Compute net revenue (gross minus refunds) for P003 in August and September
Q21.sql:
SELECT date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
       SUM(CAST(o.unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) * CAST(o.quantity AS DOUBLE)) AS gross_revenue,
       SUM(CAST(r.amount_usd AS DOUBLE)) AS total_refunds,
       SUM(CAST(o.unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) * CAST(o.quantity AS DOUBLE)) - SUM(CAST(r.amount_usd AS DOUBLE)) AS net_revenue
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
LEFT JOIN WHYDROP_PG.refunds r
  ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.product_id = 'P003'
  AND date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;
